Card Q&A.a: If one of your level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in its traits is in the battle area, you may use this Option card even when you don't have a red and black Digimon or Tamer in play.
Card Q&A.q: What does "While you have a level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements." mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.

[Main] ＜De-Digivolve 3＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by placing 1 card with [Cyborg] in its traits from your hand or trash under 1 of your level 6 Digimon with [Machine] in its traits as its bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
